displayName: 履带式联合收割机主机 + 谷物收割割台

metadata.notes: The miniature CAD assembly is enlarged by an explicit nominal factor of 10 in the prepared geometry, contact rollers, collision and navigation configuration. These are simulation design dimensions, not verified manufacturer measurements. Host and removable combine header are separate assets. Nominal four-contact differential transport model; no harvesting or rear-steering mechanism is simulated. Fixed sensor CAD reused from the existing garage; mounting bases supported by the hood.
metadata.implementDynamics: Detachable inspected header, rigid raised transport only; no reel, crop cutting or harvesting simulation.

implementTransportBalance.scope: Nominal level-ground static check only; not a dynamic stability or real lifting-capacity rating.
